extra.//: Omit a key to disable it rather than setting it to null — Expo resolves null to {} at runtime, which reads as configured. apiUrl pins the FastAPI backend; without it the host is derived from Metro.
extra.//eas: Written by hand rather than by `eas init --id`, which needs an interactive login. Same result: this is the only thing that command adds.
extra.//revenuecat: Three separate keys, and which one is used is decided at runtime — see src/lib/purchases.js. The test key talks to RevenueCat's Test Store, which serves products and runs the whole purchase flow without App Store Connect or the Play Console. It must never reach a release build: the SDK deliberately crashes an app that ships with one. Fill revenueCatIos / revenueCatAndroid in when the store listings exist, and they take over automatically.

plugins.photosPermission: Life Replay needs access to your photos so you can add memories to your family's events.
